# Structured Report Generation

## When to use
Use when the task requires generate concise decision dashboards and auditable research reports with evidence and gate status.

## Procedure
Lead with what is executable from Iraq vs on hold; list verified path, primary citations, data age, economics, confidence, recommended cheapest experiment, QA status, approval requirement and next action. Read live SQLite data, never sample fixture numbers as facts.

## Mandatory handoff
Return: input/assumptions, steps completed, dated evidence or local record IDs, confidence, blockers, quality checks, next action. If required evidence or permission is missing, stop and mark UNVERIFIED or BLOCKED rather than guessing.

## Safety
No financial commitment, account registration, external outreach, false identity, geographic restriction bypass, or publication without explicit user approval. Avoid leaking credentials or private data.
